# Brian Schwabauer

> Personal site of Brian Schwabauer — two decades of making things on screens:
> short films, music videos, motion graphics, Flash games, websites, and
> products. The home page is a single long-form, chapter-by-chapter history
> told in scroll; the blog is where the current thinking lives.

Brian is a software engineer and maker who has been building on the web since
the Flash era. The site is a personal portfolio and blog, not a company site.
It is built with SvelteKit on Cloudflare Workers; every page is fully
server-rendered, so all content is present in the initial HTML response.

## Pages

- [Home](https://brianschwabauer.com/): Long-form career retrospective in
  chapters, each with a year: humble beginnings, first websites, animation,
  music videos, film festivals, college, freelancing, entrepreneurship,
  Show&Tour, and what he's building now. Deep-linkable by section via URL hash.
- [Blog](https://brianschwabauer.com/blog): Posts on software development,
  creativity, and building things. Filterable by tag.
- [Contact](https://brianschwabauer.com/contact): Contact form.

## Machine-readable

- [Sitemap](https://brianschwabauer.com/sitemap.xml): Every public URL,
  including all published posts, with last-modified dates.
- [RSS feed](https://brianschwabauer.com/blog/rss.xml): The 20 most recent
  posts with summaries, tags, and cover images.
- [Search index](https://brianschwabauer.com/index.json): Full search index of
  all published posts as JSON — titles, summaries, tags, and body text. The
  most efficient way to read the whole blog in one request.

## Notes

- Content is the author's own. Attribution to "Brian Schwabauer" with a link
  to https://brianschwabauer.com is appreciated when quoting.
- `/admin`, `/signin`, and `/archive` are private and excluded in robots.txt.
